data.notes: September 2026 is already anchored by a stadium pop date, Festival•B at Parc del Fòrum, and a run of Razzmatazz/La Terrrazza club and concert bookings, with some civic festival programming still likely to be announced later.

events.title: The Weeknd: After Hours til Dawn Tour
events.summary: The Weeknd brings the After Hours til Dawn Tour to Barcelona’s Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys on 1 September 2026. The Barcelona date is listed by promoter Live Nation Spain.

events.title: Festival•B 2026
events.summary: Festival•B returns to Parc del Fòrum from 17–19 September 2026 with confirmed artists including Rusowsky, Yung Beef, La Plazuela, Mushka, Akriila, Maria Arnal and C Marí. The festival focuses on emerging alternative, urban and electronic scenes.

events.title: Jackies Open Air Daytime w/ Very Special Guest
events.summary: Barcelona house label and party brand Jackies hosts an open-air daytime session at La Terrrazza on 5 September 2026. The lineup is listed as a special guest TBA playing open-to-close.

events.title: Output pres. Apollonia + Sonja Moonear
events.summary: Output Barcelona, Les Enfants Brillants and Seaseaclub present Apollonia and Sonja Moonear at Seaseaclub Barcelona on 5 September 2026. RA lists the event as running from Saturday afternoon into Sunday evening, with additional artists TBC.

events.title: The Living Tombstone: The Multiplayer Tour
events.summary: Electronic-rock duo The Living Tombstone play Razzmatazz 1 on 7 September 2026 as part of The Multiplayer Tour. The venue lists the show with an 8:30 PM start and tickets via Live Nation/Ticketmaster.

events.title: Sina Bathaie: White Lotus World Tour
events.summary: Multi-instrumentalist and producer Sina Bathaie brings the White Lotus World Tour to Luz de Gas on 10 September 2026. RA lists the show with deep-house and downtempo tags.

events.title: Ciro y Los Persas
events.summary: Argentine rock act Ciro y Los Persas play Razzmatazz 1 on 18 September 2026. The venue lists the Barcelona show in the context of the band’s return to Spanish stages in September 2026.

events.title: Throwback - 8th Anniversary at La Terrrazza
events.summary: Throwback Barcelona celebrates its 8th anniversary at La Terrrazza on 18 September 2026 with an open-air party focused on 80s, 90s and 00s classics. RA lists Mr Majestyk plus TBA on the lineup.

events.title: Tyla's Dogs D'Amour: Celebrating 40 Years of Rains & 65 Years of Disgrace
events.summary: Tyla’s Dogs D’Amour play Razzmatazz 3 on 12 September 2026 as part of a September tour. The venue bills the show around Tyla’s rock’n’roll catalogue and 40 years of Rains & Disgrace.

events.title: Transvision Vamp - Spain 2026
events.summary: British band Transvision Vamp play Razzmatazz 2 on 25 September 2026. The venue describes the show as a return to the stage featuring the band’s best-known hits.

events.title: The Damned
events.summary: UK punk pioneers The Damned play Razzmatazz 2 on 26 September 2026 as part of a Spain run marking 50 years of the band. The venue notes a set spanning their punk and gothic-rock eras.

events.title: Fat Freddy's Drop: 21st Anniversary of Based On A True Story
events.summary: New Zealand band Fat Freddy’s Drop play Razzmatazz 1 on 27 September 2026, celebrating the 21st anniversary of Based On A True Story. The venue highlights the group’s blend of reggae, soul, dub, jazz-funk and electronic influences.
